verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench ships software tools (Document Driver, Capital Calculator, Liquidation Calculator), so offering scoped API credentials for agents is a fair axis. However, nothing in the evidence documents an API, API keys, or credential scoping. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec (all paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
